interac_context: The page warns never to pay unexpected fees or bills with e-transfers.

kill_chain_signals.contact: Fraudsters contact victims via phone calls, text messages and emails with links and attachments
kill_chain_signals.pretext: Fraudsters use urgency, fear and emotional manipulation to pressure victims with unexpected requests for funds, fees, job offers or investment opportunities
kill_chain_signals.payment: Victims are pressured into making quick financial decisions and told to pay with cryptocurrency, gift cards or e-transfers

red_flags: Urgency, fear and emotional manipulation to pressure quick financial decisions
Requests to pay fees or bills with cryptocurrency, gift cards or e-transfers
Caller requests personal information without verified identity
Links and attachments in text messages and emails
key_quote: Fraudsters often use urgency, fear and emotional manipulation to pressure victims into making quick financial decisions.
title: Financial Literacy Month – let's talk about money and fraud prevention
